clock-fixture-now.message: test-audit clock: anchor a fixture time to a fixed instant the test holds the clock at, never the real clock at load (docs/testing.md)

restore-renewal-transport.message: test-audit fake: install a test-owned API when a test restores and renews through the shared session manager (docs/testing.md)

hosted-predicate-wait.message: test-audit snapshot: wait for a hosted screen through HostedScreen.waitUntil, which checks between run-loop turns; an NSPredicate expectation can miss a true condition while the main thread is busy (docs/testing.md)

clock-unscoped-crons.message: test-audit heavy: limit long clock advances to the interval crons the test needs (docs/testing.md)
